caption: A skateboarder rolls along a smooth concrete path, maintaining a steady pace.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A skateboarder rolls along a smooth concrete path, maintaining a steady pace. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The skateboarder must maintain balance while rolling forward on the concrete path.
The skateboarder's feet must remain securely positioned on the board throughout the motion.
The skateboard must roll smoothly without abrupt stops or stalling.
The skateboarder must keep a consistent pace along the path without significant acceleration or deceleration.
